notes: Profile: Mid-market analytics SaaS — product search + embedded assistant inside product UI.
Current stack: heavy use of embeddings + OpenAI chat endpoints for UI assistant and contextual summarization.
Business driver: reduce per-user inference cost and get predictable throughput for launch of 'Insights Pro' tier.
Timeline: evaluating Hosted first (fast migration), then move to Dedicated for committed capacity and VPC controls.
POC ask (hosted): replicate three core flows — short chat (3–6 turns), semantic document search (top-k embeddings), and reranking for recommendation pipeline.
Latency/throughput targets: p95 < 250ms for single-turn chat golden path, sustained 100–150 qps for embedding lookup + rerank pipeline; peak burst tolerance to 300 qps.
Cost sensitivity: medium-high. Target unit cost reduction ~25–40% vs current provider; willingness to commit for lower unit economics if regressions are minimal.
Model preference: open models acceptable; want model catalog entries and verified perf profiles. Will test 7B–13B variants and quantized builds for Dedicated.
Security/compliance notes: Must support SSO/SAML, audit logs retained 1 year, KMS integration for key management, and option for data residency in us-east-1.

Technical concerns raised on call: prompt parity (templating, function-calling differences), tokenizer discrepancies causing different token counts and cost, and generation regressions on 10% of edge prompt corpus.

Incumbent migration details: currently on OpenAI — want an OpenAI-compatible compat layer in Hosted to minimize code changes. Will run A/B for 2 weeks: 80% traffic to incumbent, 20% to Redwood Hosted for regression monitoring.

Observed regressions during mini-POC: a few hallucination regressions on coverage prompts; subtle rerank score differences leading to swapped top-3 in 6% of cases. Team wants example-driven eval harness to catch regressions before Dedicated cutover.
SE notes (Ravi): work with SDK shim + tokenization mapping; recommend Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching/caching and a plan to enable KV cache tuning on Dedicated.
Commercial thread: asked for two flavors of Dedicated pricing — 6-month pilot commit and 2-year discounted commit. Needs a draft SOW and price schedule by 2026-03-18 to present to procurement.
Quote from product lead: 'We can't tolerate a drop in relevance even if cost is better — parity is requirement #1.'

Operational asks: route-based cost/latency dashboards, per-route token breakdown, ability to pin model version per route for canary rollouts, and automatic fallback to smaller model if latency spikes.

Suggested POC plan: 1) Hosted compat layer + A/B for 2 weeks, 2) run evals on 5k prompt set for regression thresholds, 3) Dedicated sizing exercise (estimate GPUs and burst), 4) finalize SOW and procurement approvals.
Next sync: pricing walkthrough + Dedicated sizing call with infra on 2026-03-16 (Sofia/Ravi/Product lead).
Short-term next steps (internal): attach eval harness to Fireflies transcript, open REDW ticket for tokenizer mapping, prepare pricing scenarios (pilot vs 2-yr).

migration_plan: Phase 1: Hosted OpenAI-compatible shim; mirror existing API surface for minimal code change.
Phase 2: A/B 2-week traffic split; collect regen/relevance metrics and token accounting.
Phase 3: Iterate prompts using evaluation harness; patch regressions and pin model versions.
Phase 4: Dedicated sizing + VPC setup; migrate traffic with canary rollouts and fallbacks.
Phase 5: Post-migration audit and SLA handover to CSM/ops.
